SAMT-BU Docs brings together professional and technical documentation for the project **Seamless Services for Children and Young People (SAMT-BU)** (*Sammenhengende tjenester for barn og unge*).

This site is open to everyone. Professionals, architects, developers and partners will find descriptions of needs, architecture, frameworks and technical documentation here. Anyone can also contribute content.
